mn34:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vajjīsu viharati Ukkācelāyaṃ Gaṅgāya nadiyā tīre.
mn34:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn34:2.1: Bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave Māgadhako gopāloko duppaññajātiko vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye asamavekkhitvā Gaṅgāya nadiyā oriman-tīraṃ asamavekkhitvā pārimantīraṃ atitthen' eva gāvo patāresi uttaran-tīraṃ Suvidehānaṃ.
mn34:3.1: Atha kho bhikkhave gāvo majjhe Gaṅgāya nadiyā sote āmaṇḍaliyaṃ karitvā tatth' eva anayabyasanaṃ āpajjiṃsu;
mn34:3.3: Tathā hi so bhikkhave Māgadhako gopālako duppaññājātiko vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye asamavekkhitvā Gaṅgāya nadiyā oriman-tīraṃ asamavekkhitvā pāriman-tīraṃ atitthen' eva gāvo patāresi uttaran-tīraṃ Suvidehānaṃ.
mn34:3.4: Evam-eva kho bhikkhave ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā akusalā imassa lokassa akusalā parassa lokassa, akusalā Māradheyyassa akusalā a-Māradheyyassa, akusalā Maccudheyyassa akusalā a-Maccudheyyassa, tesaṃ ye sotabbaṃ saddahātabbaṃ maññissanti tesaṃ taṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
mn34:4.1: Bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave Māgadhako gopālako sappaññajātiko vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye samavekkhitvā Gaṅgāya nadiyā oriman-tīraṃ samavekkhitvā pāriman-tīraṃ titthen' eva gāvo patāresi uttaran-tīraṃ Suvidehānaṃ.
mn34:5.1: So paṭhamaṃ patāresi ye te usabhā gopitaro gopariṇāyakā,
mn34:5.2: te tiriyaṃ Gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamaṃsu;
mn34:5.4: te pi tiriyaṃ Gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamaṃsu;
mn34:5.6: te pi tiriyaṃ Gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamaṃsu;
mn34:5.8: te pi tiriyaṃ Gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamaṃsu.
mn34:5.9: Bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave vacchako taruṇako tāvad-eva jātako mātu goravakena vuyhamāno so pi tiriyaṃ Gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamāsi;
mn34:5.11: Tathā hi so bhikkhave Māgadhako gopāloko sappaññajātiko vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye samavekkhitvā Gaṅgāya nadiyā oriman-tīraṃ samavekkhitvā pāriman-tīraṃ titthen' eva gāvo patāresi uttaran-tīraṃ Suvidehānaṃ. \ [...

mn34:6.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave ye te usabhā gopitaro gopariṇāyakā te tiriyaṃ Gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamaṃsu,
mn34:6.2: evam-eva kho bhikkhave ye te bhikkhū arahanto khīṇāsavā vusitavanto katakaraṇīyā ohitabhārā anuppattasadatthā parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojanā samma-d-aññā vimuttā, te pi tiriyaṃ Mārassa sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gatā.
mn34:7.1: Seyyathā pi te bhikkhave balavagavā dammagavā tiriyaṃ Gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamaṃsu,
mn34:7.2: evam-eva kho bhikkhave ye te bhikkhū pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātikā tatthaparinibbāyino anāvattidhammā tasmā lokā, te pi tiriyaṃ Mārassa sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gamissanti.
mn34:8.1: Seyyathā pi te bhikkhave vacchatarā vacchatariyo tiriyaṃ Gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamaṃsu,
mn34:8.2: evam-eva kho bhikkhave ye te bhikkhū tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmino sakid-eva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhass' antaṃ karissanti, te pi tiriyaṃ Mārassa sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gamissanti.
mn34:9.1: Seyyathā pi te bhikkhave vacchakā kisabalakā tiriyaṃ Gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamaṃsu,
mn34:9.2: evam-eva kho bhikkhave ye te bhikkhū tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyanā, te pi tiriyaṃ Mārassa sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gamissanti.
mn34:10.1: Seyyathā pi so bhikkhave vacchako taruṇako tāvad-eva jātako mātu goravakena vuyhamāno tiriyaṃ Gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamāsi,
mn34:10.2: evam-eva kho bhikkhave ye te bhikkhū dhammānusārino saddhānusārino, te pi tiriyaṃ Mārassa sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gamissanti.
mn34:11.1: Ahaṃ kho pana bhikkhave kusalo imassa lokassa kusalo parassa lokassa, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ kusalo Māradheyyassa kusalo a-Māradheyyassa, kusalo Maccudheyyassa kusalo a-Maccudheyyassa.
